title: Lisbon Therapists & Coaches Connect - Professional Challenges Discussion Group
description: Please join us for our regular Women's discussion and support group on questions and challenges when working in the coaching, therapeutic and healing professions. This is a facilitated group discussion in which each participant will have an opportunity to share and receive support from the group on a professional question or challenge they are currently experiencing - whether related to developing a niche, expertise or practice, working in Portugal, sole-entrepreneurship or any other professional topic. It is also an opportunity to connect, chat and share stories and experiences with fellow practitioners living in the Lisbon area :) This is open to both our existing members and newcomers - so if you are a coach, therapist, counselor or healer based permanently in the Lisbon area, looking to connect with fellow professionals and contribute to our beautiful community, we would love to meet you! The event will be facilitated by Niah Sommers (Systemic Couple and Family Psychotherapist). **Meet-Up Format** * 6.00pm to 6.15pm - Welcome and introductions * 6.15pm to 7.30pm - Facilitated group discussion in which each participant will have an opportunity to receive support from the group * 7.30pm to 8pm - Key takeaways and closing. * 8pm onwards - Opportunity for further connection and optional dinner. Please arrive promptly by 6.15pm in order to be able to participate fully and so as not to disrupt the energy of the group. **Practicalities** The event will take place at Honest Greens Avenida (we will be downstairs in the cafe area). There is no charge for attendance but we recommend a purchase of at least €5 of food and/or drink to support the venue. *Note: This event is open to our **women-presenting community only**, and is aimed at those who are already practicing or in training in the coaching, therapeutic and healing professions and based permanently in the Lisbon area.* *If you have any questions, please reach out to one of the Organizers.* **About Lisbon Therapists & Coaches Connect** Lisbon Therapists & Coaches Connect is a strong and diverse community of Lisbon area-based professionals with various coaching, therapeutic and healing specialisms, established in 2022. We meet regularly to share our knowledge and experiences in order to help each other learn, grow and develop, support each other and discuss interesting topics relevant to our practices.
